Question: A polynomial \[ \begin{aligned} &P(x) = c_{2004} x^{2004} + c_{2003} x^{2003} \\ &\quad {}+ \cdots + c_1 x + c_0 \end{aligned} \] has real coefficients with \(c_{2004} \ne 0\) and \(2004\) distinct complex zeros \(z_k = a_k + b_k i,\) \(1 \le k \le 2004\) with \(a_k\) and \(b_k\) real, \(a_1 = b_1 = 0,\) and \[\sum_{k=1}^{2004} a_k = \sum_{k=1}^{2004} b_k.\] Which of the following quantities can be a nonzero number?
